COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Jan-26-2004 Vacated
MINI MINUTES: This Cause came as assigned from the Presiding Judge Master Calendar for Court Trial.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patty Lee Hubble.
Richard Alexander Esq., for Plaintiff: Carrie M. Bagley, also present.
Defendants: Nicole Ford and Ralph Paige present in pro per.
10;15 a.m. - Parties reached a settlement by stipulation.
Terms of the settlement were read into the record in Chambers as follows:
Defendants shall vacate the premises located at 2431 Post St., San Francisco and return keys to Plaintiff, no later that 4:00 p.m. on Feb. 9, 2004.
Plaintiff waives rents, per diem damages, fees and costs and dismissed with prejudice.
If Defendants fail to vacate as stated, plaintiff is entitled to judgment upon ex parte 24 hours notice to the Defendants.
Security deposit shall be dealt with in accordance to Cal. Law.
No stay of excution or stay of eviction in this matter.
Parties understand, agreed and signed the agreement.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
